U9 done: the sidebar's bottom rows are fixed and each can be switched off per project.

FILES/WHAT: src/model.ts (Project.sidebarHidden?: string[] -- additive metadata, saved like sidebarOrder; only read/comments/history are honoured). src/components/ProjectSidebar.tsx: the order is now topOrder (sidebarOrder filtered to collapsibleGroups, missing ones appended) followed by bottomGroups in their fixed order minus hiddenGroups, and Settings is never hidden; moveGroup only reorders the three top groups and writes sidebarOrder as [...top, ...bottomGroups]; bottom groups render no .group-actions, are draggable="false", accept no group drop, and always use list view (views[id] is ignored for them); "Move down" is disabled on the third top group (index === collapsibleGroups.length - 1) instead of the old last-index test; new prop hiddenGroups?: string[]. src/App.tsx passes hiddenGroups={project.sidebarHidden ?? []} and adds a Settings > Sidebar section (after General) with "Show Read manuscript", "Show Comments", "Show Snapshots & history", checked = shown, each writing mutate((p) => ({ ...p, sidebarHidden: next })) with next built in the fixed read/comments/history order. src/model.test.ts: new round-trip case (structuredClone + JSON, validateProject does not throw). src-tauri/src/store.rs: extended_project_metadata_survives_save_and_restart now also inserts sidebarHidden ["comments"] (test only). tests/sidebar-selection.spec.ts: three new cases.

DEVIATION (worth knowing): the plan step 3 guard "if the current destination becomes hidden, setDestination(manuscript) and setMode(write)" is written, but it cannot fire from here: the only surface that adds to sidebarHidden is this Settings section, and while it renders, the destination is always "settings" (TypeScript proved it -- comparing a value narrowed to "settings" with the read/comments/history union is a TS2367 error, which is why the code reads (destination as string) === id). It is kept as a guard for any future surface that toggles a switch while standing on that destination. Recorded rather than silently dropped.

DESIGN DOC (for U20 to fold in; no task may edit docs/design-system.md): the sidebar has three reorderable top groups (Manuscript, Fragments, Research) and four fixed bottom rows (Read manuscript, Comments, Snapshots & history, Settings) that never reorder and carry no hover icons; each bottom feature can be switched off per project in Settings > Sidebar, and Settings itself is never hidden.

Reviewer: any agent other than agent-272b (I authored it). Hardest things to check: (1) bottom rows cannot be reordered or dragged and show no actions, while top groups still can; (2) a switch hides the row, survives reload, and does not affect another project; (3) the fail-first really is the hidden-row case failing when switches are ignored.
